title: Automatic Debit Authorisation Terms for Equipment & Vehicle Loans Installments
content:
## Terms in force

1. **Member's own instruction.** Automatic debit of Equipment & Vehicle Loans installments is authorised, moved or cancelled only on the member's own instruction, with the checking account identified by the last four digits the member gives, recorded exactly as given.
2. **Loan status.** Autopay may be changed only while the loan is in active, deferred or nonaccrual status.
3. **Debits.** Once enrolled, each installment is debited on its due date for the unpaid installment.
4. **Rate on cancellation and on a change of account.** On a product whose autopay rate discount is above zero the discount is removed on the cancellation date under the pricing policy; moving the debit to another account leaves the rate unchanged.

## Loan status and autopay changes

| Loan status on record | Autopay may be authorised, moved or cancelled |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| deferred | yes |
| nonaccrual | yes |
| applied, paid off or declined | no |

## Changes side by side

| Instruction from the member | Account | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Move the debit to another account | the new last four digits, exactly as given | unchanged |
| Cancel autopay | — | discount removed on the cancellation date (product with an autopay discount above zero) |

## Hypothetical illustration

An installment of 1450.00 falls due on 15 October and 450.00 of it has already been paid; on 15 October the automatic debit takes the unpaid 1000.00.

## Clauses no longer in force

- "On a product whose autopay rate discount is above zero the discount is added on the enrolment date" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.

The autopay discount named here remains the product's figure in the schedule of rates.

superseded_clauses: On a product with autopay_rate_discount_pct above zero the discount is added on the enrolment date
